spots.name: Rock of Ages Lighthouse
spots.tip: Lighthouses make strong silhouettes at dusk and pair well with blue hour once the light is on.

spots.name: Mount Desor
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 418 m (1,371 ft).

spots.name: Sugar Mountain
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 405 m (1,329 ft).

spots.name: Agate Beach
spots.tip: Low tide and wet sand give reflections at sunset. Check the tide table and never turn your back on the waves.

spots.name: Attwood Beach
spots.tip: Low tide and wet sand give reflections at sunset. Check the tide table and never turn your back on the waves.

spots.name: Grace Creek Overlook
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.
